plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Code tidy-up of the faster download path (no change in behavior). Long tracks (over about 10 MB, e.g. 12+ minutes) no longer download at a crawl and hold up other tracks: the file is fetched in 10 MB pieces, as YouTube requires for full speed. Faster track starts: stream links are resolved in-process using the already-running Node helper instead of starting a fresh yt-dlp and Node process per track, and the download waits the few seconds YouTube now requires before a new stream link becomes valid instead of being refused and falling back to the slow path. Previously: a background prefetch no longer makes a track you're actually starting wait behind it for its stream link. Previously: fixes My Library and other personal playlists getting capped at around 100 tracks. Also: Artists and Albums are sorted alphabetically (albums by artist, then title), and all followed artists are listed, not just the first 500; fixes the server running out of memory on small machines when two tracks start at once; real section names in New Releases; new icon; "Go to artist" / "Go to album" in every track's menu; tracks no longer stop early when a download is cut off; Podcasts menu hidden. Based on upstream 1.5.1, plus download priority within 2 downloads.
